short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: My headlights dim when I start the car!
short_scenes.narration: Every time Volt starts his car, the headlights dim for a moment. Why?
A real battery has internal resistance. Watch: as the load draws more current, the voltage at the terminals drops.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Every battery has a hidden resistor!
short_scenes.narration: The starter motor draws a huge current, so the battery voltage dips, and so do the lights.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Watch the full video: Voltage & Current Sources!
short_scenes.narration: For the detailed explanation, watch the full video on our channel. It's part of our complete Network Theory course.
